title: Follow existing repository design conventions
summary: Before implementing or refactoring code, inspect existing patterns and design conventions in the repository and align with them rather than improvising ad-hoc designs.
strategy: Inspect existing sibling implementations and callers in the target module before writing new code.
Follow established parameter patterns, helper abstractions, and separation of concerns rather than overloading existing parameters or improvising ad-hoc flags.
Verify new changes match the surrounding architecture before finalizing.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev

title: Write docs as current state
summary: Document the current state directly without narrating intermediate progress or past decisions.
strategy: Write features and usage in the present tense as the current state.
Omit intermediate progress, past decisions, and stale terminology.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev

title: Keep changes minimal unless refactoring is necessary
summary: Keep code changes minimal and surgical; avoid unnecessary refactoring unless strictly required.
strategy: Make the smallest surgical change that solves the issue without touching unrelated code or signatures.
Avoid speculative refactoring unless it is strictly required for correctness or explicitly requested.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev

title: Do not hard-wrap lines in Markdown docs
summary: Write Markdown paragraphs and list items without hard-wrapping lines across all repositories.
strategy: Keep each Markdown paragraph or list item on a single line without manual line breaks.
Disable or avoid automatic line-wrapping formatting in documentation edits across all repositories.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev
